Package edu.cnu.mdi.item

Class LineItem

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.item.AItem
edu.cnu.mdi.item.LineItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFeedbackProvider, IDrawable, EventListener
public class LineItem extends AItem
A simple AItem representing a world-coordinate line segment.

The line geometry is stored in AItem._line (world coordinates). Rendering and hit-testing are performed in screen space via the supplied IContainer transforms.

This item supports ItemModificationType DRAG and ItemModificationType RESIZE modifications. Rotation is currently a no-op (consistent with the prior implementation).
